definitions.short: properly, heed , i.e. purpose ; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that
definitions.usage: because of, to the end (intent) that, for (to,... 's sake), lest, that, to.
definitions.full: H4616. maan [ מַ֫עַן ] substantive purpose, intent , only with לְ , in לְמַ֫עַן 271 preposition and conjunction for the sake of, on account of, to the intent or in order that (abbreviated from מַעֲנֶה : compare מַ֫עַל ; Kö ii. 116 ); — with suffix לְמַעַנְךָ לְמַעֲנִי, , and לְמַעַנְכֶם ; — 1. preposition : — a. Gen 18:24 wilt thou ... not spare the place הציקים חמשׁים למען for the sake of the 50 righteous? Deut 30:6 ׳ל חַיֶּיךָ for thy life's sake , 1Kin 8:41 the foreigner who comer from afar ׳ל שְׁמֶ֑ךָ , Isa 43:14 בָבֶ֫לָה שִׁלַּחְתִּי לְמַעַנְכֶם , 45:4 ; 62:1 ׳ל ציון , 63:17 ׳ל עבדיך , 65:8 ; Ezek 36:22 (twice in verse); Job 18:4 ; Psa 122:8 ; 122:9 ; ( ד ׳עַבְדִּי ) דָּוִד לְמַעַן , i.e. for the sake of David's memory, and the promises given to him, 1Kin 11:12-13 , 32 , 34 ; 15:4 ; 2Kin 8:19 ; 19:34 (= Isa 37:35 ), 20:6 (all D 2 ); לְמַעֲנִי (of ׳י ) for my own sake , i.e. to vindicate my name, 2Kin 19:34 (= Isa 37:35 ), 2Kin 20:6 ; Isa 43:25 ; 48:11 אֶעֲשֶׁה לְמַעֲנִי לְמַעֲנִי , so לְמַעַנְךָ Dan 9:19 , ׳ל אֲדֹנָי 9:17 ; ׳י is said (or entreated) to act ( שְׁמִי שִׁמְךָ, ) שְׁמוֺ לְמַעַן i.e. to maintain his reputation, or character, Psa 23:3 ; 25:11 ; 31:4 ; 79:9 ; 106:8 ; 143:11 ; Jer 14:7 , 21 ; Ezek 20:9 , 14 , 22 , 44 ; Isa 48:9 ; simile ׳ל חַסְדְּךָ (i.e. to maintain it consistently) Psa 6:5 ; Psalm 44:27, ׳ל טוּבְךָ 25:7 , ׳ל צִדְקוֺ Isa 42:21 . b. In view of, on account of (but not expressing causation distinctly, like מִן 2f , or מִמְּנֵי ), Deut 3:26 י ׳ויתעבר לְמַעַנְכֶם בי on your account , 1Kin 11:39 ׳ל זֹאת in view of this , ׳ל שׁוֺרֲרַי on account of my watchful foes, Psa 5:9 ; 27:11 , ׳ל צורריך 8:3 , simil. 69:19 ; 48:12 ( 97:8 ) ל ֗֗֗ ציון הר ׳ישמח משׁפטיך in view of thy judgments. c. Sq. infinitive Gen 18:19 י הָבִיא ׳לְמַעַן for the purpose of J.'s bringing = to the intent that J. might bring, 37:22 ׳ל הַצִּיל in order to rescue , 50:20 ; Exod 1:11 ; 9:16 ; 10:1 , etc., Deut 2:30 ; Deuteronomy 6:28, etc., 2Kin 10:19 ; Jer 7:10 , 18 ; 11:5 ; 50:34 (on הִרגיע , see עַד 2a b ), Ezek 14:5 ; 21:5 ; 22:6 etc., 36:5 , + often (Kö iii.595 f. ). Once, pleonastic, לֵב לָמוּג לְמַעַן 21:20 (compare לְ כַּעֲבוּר 1Chr 19:3 ; but read probably הִמּוֺג ). 2. conjunction (followed by imperfect): — a. אֲשֶׁר לְמַעַן Gen 18:19 I have known him ׳ל יְצַוֶּה אשׁר to the end that he might command, etc., Deut 27:3 ; Josh 3:4 ; 2Sam 13:5 ; Jer 42:6 ; more often b. without אשׁר , as Gen 12:13 לִי יִיטַב לְמַעַן , 27:25 ; Exod 4:5 ׳ל יאמינו , 8:6 ; 8:18 ; 9:29 ; 10:2 ; Isa 5:19 ; 23:16 ; Psa 9:15 ; Psalm 30:13; 48:14 + often (Kö iii.571 ). c. Sq. לֹא (a) ׳ל לֹא אשׁר Num 17:5 ; Deut 20:18 ; Ezek 31:14 ; 36:30 ; 46:18 ; (b) ׳ל לֹא 14:11 ; 19:9 ; 25:10 ; 26:20 ; Zech 12:7 ; Psa 119:11 ; 119:80 ; 125:3 (Kö iii.574. Less common than לְבִלְתִּי or מִן with infinitive, or מֶּןֿ ). Note 1 — לְמַעַן is always in order that , never merely so that ἐκβατικῶς ); but sometimes, in rhetorical passages, the issue of a line of action, though really undesigned, is represented by it ironically as if it were designed: Deut 29:18 (see Dr) ל ֗֗֗ כִּלְבָבוֺ ׳וְהִתְבָּרֵךְ וגו ׳סְפוֺת and he congratulate himself ... in order to sweep away the moistened with the dry (i.e. to destroy all together), Isa 30:1 ; 44:9 ל ידעו ובל יראו ׳בל יֵבוֺשׁוּ in orer that they may be put to shame, Jer 7:18 ׳ל הַכְעִיסֵנִי , 7:19 ׳ל פְנֵיהֶם בּשֶׁת , 27:10 , 15 ; 32:29 ; Hosea 8:4 their silver, etc., they have made into idols ׳ל יִכָרֵת in order that it may be cut off (of course, not the real purpose of the idolatry), Amos 2:7 ; Micah 6:16 : compare Psa 51:6 (see Comn.) in order that thou mightest be just when thou judgest (that is, by manifesting thy justice in judgement on my sin). compare Qor 28:7 (Fl Kl. Schr. i. 397 f. ). Note 2. — In Josh 4:24 for the anomalous ׳ל יְרָאתֶם , read infinitive ׳ל יִרְאָתָם in order that they might fear (Dr § 14 Obs .): Neh 6:13 אִירָא לְמַעַן הוּא שָׂכוּר לְמַעַן (si vera 1.) the first ׳ל points forwards, to this intent was he hired, to the intent that I should be afraid. — On Prov 16:4 , see מַעֵנֶה above
